The Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No.6, Municipal Corporation Compound, Ahmedabad  made a Reference to this Court on the question whether the sanctioning authority is  r e q u i r e d t o g i v e r e a s o n s i n w r i t i n g f o r  granting sanction for prosecution under Section 20 (1) of the Prevention of Food  Adulteration Act, 1954.
This Reference need not be answered in view of law now being settled  t h a t n o r e a s o n s a r e r e q u i r e d t o b e a s s i g n e d f o r g r a n t i n g  sanction under Section 20(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
opennyai_summary.decision: This  Reference is accordingly disposed of.
